standard_prerequisites.name: Residual space factorization
standard_prerequisites.use: Factorization through the residual space at the base point.

core_obligations: (1) implies (2): the base-changed fibres are universally bounded by the base-change lemma.
(2) implies (1): factor through the residual space; the residual space is decent with the same points, so the fibres over it bound the fibres over the base.
The equivalence of the two properties over the point follows from the factorization being a closed immersion with one point.
proof_roadmap: Base-change boundedness; residual factorization; equivalence finish.
difficulty_reason: A transfer lemma; the residual-space factorization carries the reverse direction.
